basis: Calibrated on plan dimension chains: outer wall faces at pixels x=247/612 span 10000 mm and y=150/878 span 20000 mm (27.32 mm/px x, 27.43 mm/px y). Perimeter declared on observed outer faces; interior dividers declared on observed ink midplanes (single-line partitions at the 2px ink line; double-line partitions wall-A/wall-B2/wall-C/wall-D/wall-E at the midpoint of their two faces). Wall thickness not drawn to scale; labels read 240, assumed 240 mm nominal. All openings placed on their measured jamb pixels; exterior opening heights from the four elevations.
